metadata.title: Platform Time Drift and Correction

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for detecting, bounding, and correcting time drift to preserve platform trust.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Clock drift detection, skew bounds, and correction mechanisms for platform systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern ensuring time drift is detected and corrected without silently undermining trust.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Time drift detection and correction depend on controlled synchronization and authoritative time sources.

metadata.remarks: Platform Time Drift and Correction defines expectations for detecting time skew, enforcing acceptable bounds, and applying correction behavior. It ensures time inaccuracies are corrected deliberately rather than propagating silently across the trusted environment.

components.title: Time Drift Detection
components.description: Detects deviation between local system clocks and authoritative platform time.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Integrity degradation caused by undetected or gradual time skew.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Monitoring mechanisms identifying anomalous or divergent state.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Time drift is monitored to detect anomalous conditions affecting system integrity.

components.title: Time Skew Bounding
components.description: Defines acceptable bounds for time skew across platform systems.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Service degradation or failure caused by excessive clock skew.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Bounded tolerance enforcement to preserve system correctness.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Acceptable time skew bounds support recovery and continuity of operations.

components.title: Time Correction Behavior
components.description: Defines how time corrections are applied to affected systems.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Privilege or logic abuse resulting from abrupt or unmanaged time changes.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Controlled, deterministic correction behavior preserving system stability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Time correction behavior preserves integrity and avoids destabilizing dependent systems.
